fact: In January-June 2026 the electronic case management system progressed but full national roll-out depends on contracting, configuration and training; eCMS Cycle 2 contracting with Synergy was advanced, with courts covered in criminal cases at a 25% baseline and 100% targeted.
title: Annual Reporting of the Joint Steering Committee on the implementation status of the Priority Plan to PBSO/PBF (semi-annual report, June 2026)
